build_game_master_for_conversation: build a conversation game master entity using the GameMaster prefab with a language model and memory bank
configure_default_scenes_for_simulation: configure default Oedipus Rex scenes with prologue and episode scene specs for participant names
create_custom_scene_specs: create custom SceneSpec instances with scene types, participants, round counts, and premise text
add_extra_components_to_game_master: add extra components to the game master with configurable insertion indices in the component order
build_scene_based_terminator: build a scene-based terminator that uses the scene tracker to determine when to end the simulation
